OPDA · Local style exploration · 12 September 2026

From evidence to shared meaning

28 visual treatments of the same process. Compare the drawing, materials and tone; select an image to enlarge it.

Revision cycle: Prepare candidate → Publish candidate → Working-group review → Collect feedback → Prepare candidate. Source material enters preparation; consensus exits review to a draft standard.

Small 960 × 640 previews. Generated artwork is for style comparison, not a final verified diagram. Some arrows are missing or reversed; use the written revision cycle above as the process reference. Coverage: 11 core recipes, three additional directions from the earlier gallery, and 14 marketing treatments. These include related variants and mixed-media combinations; they are not 28 unrelated media. The homepage has not been changed.

Core style recipes 01–11

01

Translucent watercolour

Transparent watercolour; layered washes, reserved paper highlights, restrained pigment granulation, selected soft edges.

Generation brief

Use case: infographic-diagram. Create ONE small landscape style-study preview, requested 960 x 640 pixels, not a production high-resolution image. Subject: "From evidence to shared meaning", a six-box human-governed candidate revision process. Keep white/off-white paper, OPDA purple #231F2F, teal #0E8478, violet #6C5BD4, gold #FEC92B. No overall title. Exact fixed layout on 3:2 canvas: middle row Source material at far left, Prepare candidate at centre-left, Working-group review at centre-right, Draft standard at far right. Publish candidate below between Prepare and Review. Collect feedback above between Review and Prepare. Six modest rectangular boxes, large readable headings, one small distinctive material vignette inside each. Headings exactly: "Source material", "Prepare candidate", "Publish candidate", "Working-group review", "Collect feedback", "Draft standard". No body text. Six directed connections: Source -> Prepare; Prepare -> Publish; Publish -> Review; Review -> Collect feedback; Collect feedback -> Prepare; Review -> Draft. Connectors clear, no intersections or arrows through boxes. Gold only on Review -> Draft exit. No return to Source, no outgoing arrow from Draft. Vignettes: Source evidence folio; Prepare hand with pencil revising one sheet; Publish open folio on display; Review two adults comparing a sheet; Collect feedback several annotated response slips gathered by a hand into one tray; Draft a stitched manuscript without approval seal. Keep these subjects and layout for fair comparison across styles. Clean labels remain high-contrast neutral sans serif, medium is applied to vignettes and box borders. No decoration, watermark, charts, extra text or extra boxes. STYLE: Transparent watercolour; layered washes, reserved paper highlights, restrained pigment granulation, selected soft edges.

12

Architectural cutaway

Hand-drafted architectural cutaway with ink hatching and coloured pencil. Show a continuous miniature open-front studio building with six clearly distinct rooms/stations for the document process. Walls cut away to reveal actions, physically plausible stairs and room geometry. This is a spatial cutaway, NOT six framed illustrations.

13

Sequential ink narrative

Editorial comic in crisp brush and ink and flat pastel gouache. Six distinct sequential panels with the same practitioners and documents retained across panels, changing gestures to show receiving evidence, preparing, publishing, reviewing, gathering feedback, and the possible draft outcome. A clearly labelled return route from feedback to preparation, and a separate consensus route from review to draft. Not six unrelated icons.
